subject: Co-sell billing consolidation — Helix renewal path
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@helixtx.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.k@helixtx.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com, ben.carter@redwood.inference.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: co-sell billing consolidation ahead of renewal

Hi Emily / Rajesh,

Thanks again for taking the demo last week — appreciate the time. Helix's renewal is coming up in July and I wanted to propose a path that will both simplify billing for your finance team and give us a clean co-sell route with Azure that can accelerate the contract and enable a promotional discount for the first 12 months.

High level proposal (summary):
- Convert Helix to a transactable offer on Azure Marketplace (co-sell eligible).
- 12-month term on Azure with a 15% co-sell discount applied to list price for Year 1.
- Redwood to manage entitlement mapping so you retain the same seat/usage accounting.
- We’ll push a one-time migration credit equivalent to one month of average spend to offset procurement integration work.

Attachments: Helix_transition_SOW_v1.pdf, pricing_sheet_helix.xlsx, transition-checklist.xlsx

As next steps: can you confirm 1) procurement contact for charge-code / invoice policy (I see procurement@helixtx.com in the loop) and 2) if Helix requires invoice-only (PO) vs marketplace transactable? If you prefer, we can run a short 30-min call with Azure co-sell specialist + your procurement to outline timing and artifacts.

I’ve added Lauren and Ben from our teams — Lauren will own contract alignment and Ben will coordinate the co-sell onboarding with Azure.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@helixtx.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.k@helixtx.com>, procurement@helixtx.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: co-sell billing consolidation ahead of renewal

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear plan. A few quick items from our side:
- Procurement (procurement@helixtx.com) prefers invoice/PO for our ERP but we are open to marketplace if Azure can provide the same invoice trail and net-30 terms.
- Need clarity on the 15% discount mechanics and whether that impacts our existing committed pricing tiers.
- Rajesh, looping you for technical/entitlement questions.

Yes to a short call with Azure + Redwood. Can you propose 2 slots next week?

Best,
Emily Carter
Head of IT Procurement
Helix Therapeutics
emily.carter@helixtx.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@helixtx.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: co-sell billing consolidation ahead of renewal

Emily — appreciate the quick reply. A couple of clarifications from pricing/ops: 
- The 15% Year 1 co-sell discount is applied to the Redwood list price on the Azure transactable offer and can be coded as a promo at the offer level; it will not change legacy committed SKUs Helix currently uses — we’ll map entitlement so existing usage counts toward the same commitment.
- If Helix requires PO-based invoicing, Azure supports an invoice flow for marketplace purchases when working through private offers/co-sell (but it requires setup with the Azure account team). We can handle that during the co-sell onboarding.
- Timeline we recommend: create offer + co-sell enablement (2 weeks), procurement integration & invoice setup (2–3 weeks), transition verification & go-live before renewal (target 4–6 weeks total if we align resources).

I’ve uploaded the detailed pricing worksheet (pricing_sheet_helix.xlsx) and a short checklist (transition-checklist.xlsx) listing the artifacts Azure will request (MSA copy, billing contact, tenant info, entitlements mapping).

If procurement wants stricter payment terms, we can model net-30 on the marketplace billing or produce a parallel invoice flow — both workable but need procurement signoff.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com

--
